title: Om Malik has died
summary: This is an obituary memorializing Om Malik (1966-2026), a renowned tech journalist, blogger, and investor who chronicled Silicon Valley's evolution and co-founded the influential Gigaom tech publication, teaching generations of entrepreneurs and journalists about technology business.
problem_solved: This memorial acknowledges the passing of a pioneering tech journalist who documented Silicon Valley's transformation and mentored countless founders and writers.
why_valuable: It honors the legacy of a tech journalist who shaped how people understood technology business, startup culture, and Silicon Valley's ecosystem through his writing and community building.
